d1.title: Chest · Shoulders · Triceps · Abs

exercises.name: Ottoman bridge press · 8–12
exercises.detail: Ottoman against a wall so it can't slide. Upper back across it, hips up level with your knees, feet flat. Lower until the dumbbells sink below your chest: 3 sec down, 1 sec pause in the stretch, drive up. The floor press stopped your elbows short; this is the stretch that grows the chest. Last set: rest 15 sec and get more reps, twice.

exercises.name: Incline press · 10 one-and-a-half reps
exercises.detail: Torso propped on the ottoman at 30–45°. Down, half way up, back down, then all the way up: that's one rep. Upper chest.

exercises.name: Ottoman fly into squeeze press · 12 + max
exercises.detail: Superset. Upper back on the ottoman, fly with a 2 sec hold at the bottom of the stretch, then go straight into squeeze presses (dumbbells pressed together) until you can't. Makes 10 kg feel heavy.

exercises.name: Push-up drop set · each to failure
exercises.detail: No rest between: feet on the ottoman, then feet on the floor, then hands on the ottoman. Grip the dumbbell handles and let your chest sink below them.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Seated on the ottoman. Slow down, full lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise · 12–15
exercises.detail: Strict. On the last set, finish with half reps until you can't lift.

exercises.name: Overhead tricep extension · 10–12
exercises.detail: Both hands on one dumbbell. Deep stretch, slow down.

exercises.name: Tricep kickbacks · 12–15
exercises.detail: Hinge forward, elbow pinned high. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.

exercises.name: Diamond push-ups · to failure
exercises.detail: Finisher.

exercises.name: Weighted crunches · 15
exercises.detail: Dumbbell on chest. Slow.

exercises.name: Lying leg raises · 15
exercises.detail: Legs straight. Lower slow, don't let your back arch.

exercises.name: Rope intervals · 5 rounds of 2 min
exercises.detail: Each round: 1 min fast, 1 min easy bounce. The rope never stops, no rest between rounds. 10 minutes.

alt.name: Shadow rope intervals · 5 rounds of 2 min
alt.detail: Each round: 1 min fast, 1 min easy bounce. The rope never stops, no rest between rounds. 10 minutes. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

d1.cardio: The rope block is your cardio today. Want more? Another 10 min later is fine.

d2.title: Back · Biceps · Posture · Abs

exercises.name: Single-arm dumbbell row · 12–15 each side
exercises.detail: Hand and knee on the ottoman. 3 sec down, pause 1 sec at the top.

exercises.name: Bent-over two-arm row · 12–15
exercises.detail: Hinge at the hips, back flat, pull to the ribs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover · 12
exercises.detail: Across the ottoman. Both hands on one dumbbell. Big stretch for the lats.

exercises.name: Reverse fly · 15
exercises.detail: Bent over, arms out like wings. Rear delts. Light and strict.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug · 15
exercises.detail: Hold 2 sec at the top. Traps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: 3 sec down. No swinging.

exercises.name: Hammer curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: Palms facing in. Brachialis and forearm.

exercises.name: Concentration curl · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Elbow braced on the inner thigh. Squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: YTW raises (prone) · 8 each letter
exercises.detail: Face down. Arms in a Y, then T, then W.

exercises.name: Russian twist with dumbbell · 20 total
exercises.detail: Lean back, feet up if you can. Obliques.

exercises.name: Rope Tabata · 2 blocks of 4 min
exercises.detail: Each block: 8 rounds of 20 sec all out, 10 sec easy. 1 min of easy rope before each block. 10 minutes.

alt.name: Shadow rope Tabata · 2 blocks of 4 min
alt.detail: Each block: 8 rounds of 20 sec all out, 10 sec easy. 1 min of easy rope before each block. 10 minutes. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

d2.cardio: The rope block is your cardio today. Want more? Another 10 min later is fine.

d3.title: Legs · Ski Prep · Core

exercises.name: Leg swings · 10 each leg, each direction
Bulgarian split squats · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Rear foot on the ottoman, dumbbells in hand. 3 sec down.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squats · 12
exercises.detail: Deep. Every rep is one and a half: down, half up, down, all the way up.

exercises.name: Wall sit · 60 sec
exercises.detail: Thighs parallel. Hold the dumbbells on your thighs when 60 sec gets easy.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift · 10 each side
exercises.detail: Dumbbell in each hand. Hinge, flat back, slow down. Hamstrings and balance.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings · 20
exercises.detail: Hip hinge, not a squat. Explosive.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise · 15 each side
exercises.detail: On a step. Dumbbell in one hand, full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold · 30 sec
exercises.detail: Lower back pressed into the floor.

exercises.name: Steady rope · 10 min
exercises.detail: Easy, steady pace on the balls of your feet. Ski calves and ankles. Split it into 2 × 5 min if you need.

alt.name: Shadow rope · 10 min steady
alt.detail: Easy, steady pace on the balls of your feet. Ski calves and ankles. Split it into 2 × 5 min if you need. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

d3.cardio: This session counts as ski conditioning, rope included.

d4.title: Chest · Back · Shoulders · Arms · Abs

exercises.name: Incline press · 10–12
exercises.detail: Upper chest first today. Torso on the ottoman at 30–45°. 3 sec down, 1 sec pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Ottoman fly · 15
exercises.detail: Upper back across the ottoman. Slow, and hold 3 sec in the deepest stretch. Light is fine: the stretch does the work.

exercises.name: Deficit push-ups · to failure
exercises.detail: Hands on the dumbbell handles, chest below them. At failure rest 15 sec and go again, until you get fewer than 3 reps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl · 10–12
exercises.detail: Superset: go straight into the tricep extension, then rest 60 sec.

exercises.name: Hammer curl · 12
exercises.detail: Superset with the diamond push-ups.

exercises.name: Rope intervals · 2 sets of 5 rounds
exercises.detail: Each round: 40 sec fast, 20 sec easy. Fast but smooth, not all out: Max Day is tomorrow. 10 minutes.

alt.name: Shadow rope intervals · 2 sets of 5 rounds
alt.detail: Each round: 40 sec fast, 20 sec easy. Fast but smooth, not all out: Max Day is tomorrow. 10 minutes. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

d4.cardio: Max Day tomorrow. The rope block is enough; skip extra cardio so you test fresh.

d5.title: Benchmarks · Ski Legs · Abs

exercises.name: Max consecutive pushups
exercises.detail: Standard form. Log it.

exercises.name: Max single-arm row reps (at 10 kg)
exercises.detail: Strict reps. Log it.

exercises.name: Max plank hold
exercises.detail: Time it. New PR.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats · 12 each side
exercises.detail: Lighter and faster than Day 3. Burn, not grind.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise · 15
exercises.detail: Light and strict. Shoulder width.

exercises.name: Weighted crunches · 12
exercises.detail: Heavier and slower than Day 1.

exercises.name: Steady rope · 10 min
exercises.detail: After the tests. Smooth and steady. Each week, try to trip less and go a little faster.

alt.name: Shadow rope · 10 min steady
alt.detail: After the tests. Smooth and steady. Each week, try to trip less and go a little faster. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

d5.cardio: Rope block done means cardio done. Rest day tomorrow.

hiit.title: Weighted Rope · Full Body · Abs

exercises.name: Easy rope · 2 min
exercises.detail: Slow, small bounces on the balls of your feet. Wakes up the calves and ankles.

alt.name: Easy shadow rope · 2 min
alt.detail: Slow, small bounces on the balls of your feet. Wakes up the calves and ankles. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

exercises.name: Rope intervals · 30 sec hard, 30 sec easy
exercises.detail: Hard: as fast as you can with clean form. Easy: a slow bounce, the rope never stops. The weighted rope works your shoulders, arms and core too. New to the rope? Start with 6 and build to 8.

alt.name: Shadow rope intervals · 30 sec hard, 30 sec easy
alt.detail: Hard: as fast as you can with clean form. Easy: a slow bounce, the rope never stops. The weighted rope works your shoulders, arms and core too. New to the rope? Start with 6 and build to 8. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

exercises.name: Rope · 60 sec
exercises.detail: Circuit: one set of each, top to bottom, then rest 90 sec. Three rounds.

alt.name: Shadow rope · 60 sec
alt.detail: Circuit: one set of each, top to bottom, then rest 90 sec. Three rounds. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings · 15
exercises.detail: Hip hinge, explosive.

exercises.name: Deficit push-ups · 12
exercises.detail: Your third chest hit of the week. Stop 2 reps short of failure: Upper is tomorrow.

exercises.name: Bent-over two-arm row · 12
exercises.detail: Flat back, pull to the ribs.

exercises.name: Rope · 45 sec
exercises.detail: Straight into each ab set below.

alt.name: Shadow rope · 45 sec
alt.detail: Straight into each ab set below. No rope yet: same timing, no rope. Jump and turn your wrists as if you held one, or swap in jumping jacks or high knees.

hiit.cardio: This is your conditioning day. Ticking every set finishes it, or log a cardio session.
